Minigame Tests

Redneck Fishing

Ready to fish0 lb · 45 s

Cast, tap Hook when the bobber dips, then hold Reel. Use Slack during a hard pull. Lift rod when the line eases to gain line faster. Bait changes which fish you hook. Land as much weight as you can in 45 seconds. Keyboard: 1–3 choose a spot, and 4 casts, hooks, or reels.
